title: Zion flash flood: 7 canyoneers, 15 minutes #Shorts
description:
On September 14, 2015, a storm over Zion National Park sent a flash flood through Keyhole Canyon. Seven canyoneers were inside. None came out.

▶ Full documentary (Zion, Part 1: Zion's Deadliest Day): https://youtu.be/Hlr80lyDlwA

#Shorts #Zion #FlashFlood #NationalParks
